principles: Learner-first Propaedia: every part opens with an outline index and a ladder.spw (prerequisite DAG with rungs); root index.spw is the outline of knowledge and each part index is a prop_part_* anchor, so the outline is one layer.

One closed rung ladder across all fields: intro (curious public) -> foundation (lower-division) -> advanced (upper-division) -> graduate (masters/PhD coursework) -> practitioner (production, licensure, clinical or studio practice). Multi-rung nodes carry one #:level (entry rung) plus rung frames inside.

One canonical home per duplicated core: classical thermo, stat mech, EM, transport, control, signals, solids each exist once; disciplines hold needs edges into them and keep only their discipline-specific framing.
Math core before engineering: mathematics/engineering-core is the root of the prerequisite atlas; pure mathematics is a separate ladder with every theorem's hypotheses restated.
Computing gets a field: podcast year rows survive as syllabi; the podcast framing (episode numbers, 1,095-day streak) stays with podcast production.
Education is a branch, not scattered files: secondary -> higher education -> US curricula history -> intergenerational kit, feeding the owner's story as material and method only.
Visible gaps over forced completeness: propaedia/rung-gap-table.spw shows empty part x rung cells and names each gap's expected neighbors, as Mendeleev's table did.

Scientific integrity by construction: keystone claims carry a status (#!settled...#!superseded) and a registry source; corrected raw claims are recorded as #!refuted/#!superseded with the fix; invented effect sizes are not carried forward; post-cutoff facts are cells with status=to_verify.

Harm handling: physiology advice is quarantined in provenance/harms-ledger.spw (category + raw path:line, content not reproduced); health files describe curricula and cite dated guidelines; no dosing, supplement or diet guidance.

Script form follows content: syllabi for sequenced rows, state machines for lifecycles, ledgers for contested or superseded claims, matrices for comparisons, calendars and cadences for the season, dossiers for cases, batteries for probes, trails for cross-part paths.

The season is a term: Oct 1 2026 -> Jan 4 2027 gets a 14-week study calendar (propaedia) and a production calendar (media-industries), linked by a reflection -> crescendo -> celebration -> reset cadence.

Renvois are typed and downward-safe: needs/feeds/grounds/extends/contrasts/analog/supersedes/case_of edges point at sibling or cross-part anchors, never at an ancestor index; bundles transclude only children.
Facets are closed; clusters are computed prompts; the authored tree is one view among facets and trails (Borges caution), and generated questions from the question wheel are never claims.
Anchors are frozen by this plan: domain-slug prefixes, unique across the cut, so trails and cross-links written in parallel resolve.

risks: Canonical-core dedupe can erase discipline framing (chemE reads transport through balances, ME through devices); writers must keep a short discipline frame that needs the core.
Anchors are cited by trails and cross-links before files exist; any rename breaks resolution. Freeze the anchor list; run a resolve check after all packages land.

Currency: 2026 guild agreements (WGA/SAG-AFTRA/DGA 2023 contracts expired mid-2026), TikTok LIVE gates and gift values, podcast platform shares, NSF/agency budgets and state education laws may have changed past the writers' knowledge; these must be cells with status=to_verify, never asserted.

Harm drift: reframed physiology and nursing files can slide back into advice; reviewers check for imperatives, doses, supplement names and diet prescriptions; harms ledger must not restate the harmful content.

Politically contested ground: curriculum wars and public worry about schools; present positions with evidence status and sources, never verdicts; public-worry-hooks lists survey series without invented percentages.
Speculative framing: streamers as first Spw users and the clustering hybrid are proposals; mark #!speculative and keep them out of the settled layer.
Size: merges that fold 3-6 raw files (statistical-mechanics, tiktok-live-receipt, materials-graduate-and-methods, transport-phenomena) can exceed ~300 lines; split by rung before bloating.

Name hazards: LSP tier heuristics match substrings (query, expr, ops, algos, experiments, style, phase); common words like workshops, loops, crops, props, lifestyle, phases trip them. The planned tree passes (checked by script); later additions must re-check.
Ladders duplicate needs edges and can drift; later, generate ladders from edges or check them with a script.
Registry branches follow packages, so one source may be cited from two branches; allow cross-branch #>src_* refs and dedupe later rather than copying.
Internal case files draw on git history and plans; privacy hook forbids absolute user paths; summarize commits rather than quoting episode bodies.
Archive-then-delete: raw dirs must not be removed until provenance/manifest.spw checksums match the tarball and every migration target exists and parses.
Fourteen parts is itself a hard taxonomy; if facets and trails are thin, the tree ossifies (the Borges failure). Facet particles and trails are required, not optional.
Errata ledgers (provenance) and inline #!refuted claims (branches) can disagree; the branch file is authoritative and the errata row links to it.
